## Welcome to InfraPilot! 👋

This is a **good first issue** — perfect for newcomers to the project. We've labeled it as beginner-friendly to help you get started with contributing.

## What Makes This Issue Beginner-Friendly?

- Well-scoped with clear requirements
- Great for learning the codebase
- Comes with guidance and mentorship
- No complex architecture decisions needed

## Getting Started

### 1. Read the Contribution Guide
Please start by reading [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) to understand our workflow.

### 2. Set Up Your Development Environment
Follow the setup instructions to get the project running locally.

### 3. Claim This Issue
- Comment on this issue saying you'd like to work on it
- A maintainer will assign it to you
- If you have questions, ask in the comments!

### 4. Make Your Changes
- Create a new branch from `main`
- Make your changes following our [code style guidelines](../CONTRIBUTING.md#code-style)
- Write or update tests if applicable
- Ensure all tests pass

### 5. Submit a Pull Request
- Push your branch and open a PR
- Link this issue in the PR description: "Closes #issue_number"
- Fill out the PR template completely

## Mentorship Available

Don't hesitate to ask questions! If you need help:
- Comment on this issue
- Start a [GitHub Discussion](https://github.com/venkaiswami/infrapilot-enterprise/discussions)
- Reach out to [@venkaiswami](https://github.com/venkaiswami) directly
